Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server
The embedded Equinix Intelligence MCP Server — a community Model Context Protocol server, not affiliated with or endorsed by Equinix, and unrelated to Equinix's own private-beta Fabric MCP server.
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server.broker
The Safe Mutation Broker — the embedded MCP server's only route to a mutation, enforced by the server rather than by prompt discipline: agents propose, dry-run diffs decide, humans confirm.
